en.title: Gallery of Light: sculpture, space and sound
en.excerpt: Thirteen sculptures, changing materials and a layered soundtrack: an independent IOM study that invites visitors to explore how light transforms a gallery.
en.seo_title: Gallery of Light — Sculpture, Space and Sound | IOM
en.seo_description: Explore IOM's interactive gallery: thirteen sculptures, eight light and material studies, a guided tour and a six-layer soundtrack with its own mixer.
